[[File:MidPoint.jpg|230px|thumb|Debris at the Mid-Point, belonging to various craft of different factions]]

The simply named '''Mid-Point''' was an area of the [[Karthakk system]] which served as a three-way route for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], [[Nym/Legends|Nym's]] [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. For this reason, it was often the best place to witness [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfights]] and near-death misses.<ref name="JTL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mid-Point was a location in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="JTL" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
